description: Source code for creating and managing decode targets (textures and surfaces) on Android using OpenGL and JNI, specifically for the starboard platform.

methods.name: CreateSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Creates an Android SurfaceTexture object wrapping a GL texture ID.

methods.name: CreateSurfaceFromSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Creates an Android Surface object from a SurfaceTexture.

methods.name: CreateWithContextRunner
methods.description: Sets up GL texture, SurfaceTexture, Surface, and decode target data structures within a GL context.

methods.name: DecodeTargetCreate
methods.description: Creates a decode target (texture and surface) with specified format, width, and height.
